definition: to join two people or things together
description: A young man with bleached hair crouches in a dark room and flicks a wall switch, then pushes a black cable into the back of a Samsung monitor, plugs another into a Nintendo Switch dock, and pushes a plug into the front of a PC tower while tidying the cables behind the desk. The monitor lights up with a blue wallpaper, the room glows purple, and he sits back in the gaming chair looking at the finished setup.

en.question: What is the young man doing?

de.answer: Er schließt Kabel an seinen Computer an.
de.question: Was macht der junge Mann?

es.answer: Está conectando cables a su ordenador.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo el joven?

fr.answer: Il branche des câbles sur son ordinateur.
fr.question: Que fait le jeune homme ?
